meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.FracCert.HasAllMoments: The quantifier starts at homogeneous order one; this definition alone does not supply an order-zero L2 norm.
notes.Breakdown.FracCert.SmoothMomentStepSymbo: The admissibility guard deliberately handles exceptional representatives; later almost-everywhere admissibility results justify agreement with the ordinary annular restriction.
notes.Breakdown.FracCert.symbolX: The reciprocal at frequency zero is Lean's total inverse, so the value there is defined without a nonzero-frequency hypothesis.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.GradientOrthogonalS: This declaration defines a proposition; the separate provider theorem proves that proposition.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.Internal.SecondSymb: The conversion to L² is total and uses zero outside L²; the energy and pairing results separately supply membership hypotheses, so this definition alone asserts no regularity of an arbitrary input.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.StiffEnclosureInter: The bound is the Euclidean triangle inequality written for squared finite sums.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.fieldSymbol: The conversion to L² is total and uses zero outside L²; the energy and pairing results separately supply membership hypotheses, so this definition alone asserts no regularity of an arbitrary input.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.fracCertificate_pro: This implication explicitly takes both bridge propositions and the certificate hypothesis as arguments; it does not itself construct numerical certificate data, and the fractional result is outside the ordinary-dissipation paper claim.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.secondSymbol: The conversion to L² is total and uses zero outside L²; the energy and pairing results separately supply membership hypotheses, so this definition alone asserts no regularity of an arbitrary input.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.weakPowerLimit_hold: The velocity limit is recovered as the radial factor times the weak L2 limit of the inverse-radial-weighted velocities.
